speaker: hero
text: Bit, my room is a *disaster*. I don't know where to start.

speaker: bit
text: That's the real problem. Not the mess. The *start*.

speaker: bit
text: Step one. Take one photo of the *whole* room.

speaker: bit
text: Send it to an AI chat that reads *pictures*.

speaker: bit
text: Step two. Ask for a plan with a *time limit*.

speaker: hero
text: Why fifteen minutes? I need *five hours*.

speaker: bit
text: Five hours sounds scary. Fifteen minutes sounds *doable*.

speaker: bit
text: Look. It sees your room and splits it into *tiny* jobs.

speaker: hero
text: Three minutes for clothes? I can do *three minutes*.

speaker: bit
text: That's the trick. Small first, so you *keep going*.

speaker: bit
text: Step three. Done? Take a new photo. Ask: what's *next*?

speaker: hero
text: Wait. Is the AI going to *judge* my room?

speaker: bit
text: No. And if you don't want to share, describe it in *words*.

speaker: bit
text: And under the bed it found your *other sock*.

speaker: bit
text: Follow for one AI trick a day.
